description: This script performs performance tests related to Git pack bitmaps, including setup, creation, manipulation, and validation of bitmap states within a Git repository. It defines a function 'test_bitmap' that runs tests with different configurations and then executes these tests twice with varying parameters.

methods.name: test_bitmap
methods.description: Performs a series of Git repository operations and bitmap manipulations to benchmark or verify performance under different configurations specified by the 'enabled' parameter.
